sight:lore-explorable-home-3.name: A Field Guide to Executive Waterfowl
sight:lore-explorable-home-3.description: The dust jacket promises an indispensable companion for the modern naturalist.

sight:abandoned-factory.name: Abandoned building
sight:abandoned-factory.description: The windows are boarded up. Something inside is still on the clock.

place:ai-lab.name: AI Lab
place:ai-lab.description: A SoMa AI lab with a levitating cortical brain, magnetic containment rings, specimen pods, and humming GPU racks.

actor:ai-lab-recruiter.name: AI Lab recruiter
actor:ai-lab-recruiter.description: A lab recruiter clutching a clipboard labeled “general intelligence.” The entire interview fits in a calculator, which is strictly forbidden.

actor:airship-rental-attendant.name: Airship attendant
actor:airship-rental-attendant.description: A punctual attendant with a brass watch and a very long retrieval cable. Their flight schedule has exactly one departure: whenever you are ready.

sight:shared-airship-rope.name: Airship rope
sight:shared-airship-rope.description: A rope hanging from the airship basket. Climb aboard.

sight:american-industrial-center.name: American Industrial Center
sight:american-industrial-center.description: A brick-and-sawtooth workshop filled with precision tools and the sound of careful metalwork.

actor:industrial-armorer.name: Armorer
actor:industrial-armorer.description: He measures twice, sharpens once, and always checks the paperwork.

sight:personal-b2.name: B-2 Stealth Bomber
sight:personal-b2.description: Your personal flying wing, its dark fuselage disappearing into the hangar’s shadows.

sight:nia.name: Bani · café regular
sight:nia.description: A friendly woman with warm brown skin and dark curls, enjoying her coffee at a table inside Mazarine.

actor:shanghai-bartender.name: Bartender
actor:shanghai-bartender.description: A neighborhood bartender who can measure a pint, a coin, and the precise moment that the floor starts moving.

actor:ssf-battery-seller.name: Battery seller
actor:ssf-battery-seller.description: A local adventurer. Currently undertaking the difficult quest called “one more errand.”

sight:salt-flats.name: Bay Area Salt Flats
sight:salt-flats.description: A patchwork of pink, green, and silver evaporation ponds beside the South Bay. Salt crust rims the water; dirt levees keep your feet dry. A letter-writing desk stands beside the levee.

sight:baybridge.name: Bay Bridge
sight:baybridge.description: The bridge leaves the eastern waterfront for Yerba Buena Island and the East Bay.

sight:bayshore-pocket-garden.name: Bayshore Courtyard
sight:bayshore-pocket-garden.description: A little neighborhood garden: flowering pots, a shaded bench, and a thoroughly unmonetized view.

sight:bayshore-design-studio.name: Bayshore Design Studio
sight:bayshore-design-studio.description: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

sight:bayview-common.name: Bayview Common
sight:bayview-common.description: A neighborhood common with shade trees, flower beds, cedar benches, a drinking fountain and paths linking all four sides.

sight:berkeley-esoteric.name: Berkeley Institute for Esoteric Studies
sight:berkeley-esoteric.description: Copper observatories, watchful stained glass, and an armillary instrument of uncertain purpose. A tiny Berkeley campus surrounds the institute: redwoods, a campanile, a colonnaded library, and scholars with impeccable credentials in impossible coincidences. Professor Vale can certify alien evidence.

sight:bicycle.name: Bicycle
sight:bicycle.description: A red city bicycle. Ride it along Market Street and through the park. Press B to ride or park it; dismount automatically at shop doors.

actor:golden-gate-park-bison.name: Bison
actor:golden-gate-park-bison.description: An enormous, shaggy park resident. The haircut is self-maintained.

sight:bolinas.name: Bolinas
sight:bolinas.description: Weathered cottages, a coastal grocer, and a village green among the Marin hills.

actor:bolinas-grocer.name: Bolinas grocer
actor:bolinas-grocer.description: Knows a shortcut. Will probably describe it using a café that closed in 2018.

actor:bolinas-surfer.name: Bolinas surfer
actor:bolinas-surfer.description: Appears to be mentally composing a strongly worded review of the weather.

sight:bottle-post-machine.name: Bottle-post conveyor
sight:bottle-post-machine.description: I never thought about how the technology worked.

actor:twitter-bottle-worker.name: Bottle-post engineer
actor:twitter-bottle-worker.description: A backend engineer with impeccable bottle discipline. Every cork is a deployment.

sight:house-search-7.name: Bread box
sight:house-search-7.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:painted-bunny.name: Bunny
sight:painted-bunny.description: A very soft Alamo Square resident. Its entire calendar is reserved for snacks and head pats.

sight:academy.name: California Academy of Sciences
sight:academy.description: Rounded green hills form the living roof of the Academy. Skylights, gardens, and the Music Concourse make a small cultural center within the park.

sight:rail-pit.name: California high-speed rail
sight:rail-pit.description: An empty pit. The sign says California high-speed rail.

sight:centeredness-institute.name: California Institute for Consciousness Research
sight:centeredness-institute.description: The California Institute for Consciousness Research. Celestial tiles and a copper observatory promise a rigorous measurement of the ineffable. Professor Meridian still needs a research assistant with a prehensile tail.

sight:center-research-institute.name: California Institute for Consciousness Research · Field Station
sight:center-research-institute.description: The field station of the California Institute for Consciousness Research. Star charts cover the glass roof; its brass instruments are calibrated to a different consensus reality.

actor:captain-ahab.name: Captain Ahab
actor:captain-ahab.description: Carries a reusable bag with the quiet confidence of someone who remembered to bring it.

sight:house-search-1.name: Cedar chest
sight:house-search-1.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:peninsula-garden-office-69.name: Cedar Design Offices
sight:peninsula-garden-office-69.description: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

sight:house-search-3.name: Chest of drawers
sight:house-search-3.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:chinatown.name: Chinatown
sight:chinatown.description: Red pillars, green roof tiles, and Grant Avenue leading into Chinatown. Keep heading north for City Lights.

sight:cityhall.name: City Hall
sight:cityhall.description: The granite wings and gilded dome of City Hall anchor Civic Center, just west of Market Street.

actor:city-hall-clerk.name: City Hall clerk
actor:city-hall-clerk.description: An unflappable clerk. Her stamp has faced stranger paperwork than this.

place:writing.name: City Lights · Essays
place:writing.description: Pull up a chair. Essays on technology, markets, and the ideas that won't leave you alone.

sight:coit.name: Coit Tower
sight:coit.description: A pale tower above the steep streets of Telegraph Hill. North Beach sits just down the slope.

sight:conservatory.name: Conservatory of Flowers
sight:conservatory.description: A white glasshouse with a central dome, long glazed wings, and bright flower beds. The Panhandle begins a short ride to the east.

sight:cotogna.name: Cotogna
sight:cotogna.description: A brick neighborhood restaurant near Coit Tower. Neighbors eat at a table outside beneath the cotogna sign.

actor:cotogna-chef.name: Cotogna chef
actor:cotogna-chef.description: An immaculate chef with a very tall hat and very exacting standards. Will accept a fish story, but only pays for the fish.

actor:cotogna-diner-2.name: Cotogna diner
actor:cotogna-diner-2.description: A scholar of pasta, conducting an extremely thorough field study.

actor:south-cow-0.name: Cow
actor:south-cow-0.description: A local adventurer. Currently undertaking the difficult quest called “one more errand.”

sight:lost-pirate-wreck.name: Crashed pirate ship
sight:lost-pirate-wreck.description: A tricorn-sized navigational error has become a full-sized shipwreck. The tide has claimed the stern; its captain is still disputing the insurance assessment.

sight:crissy.name: Crissy Field
sight:crissy.description: A low, open meadow beside the bay, below the wooded Presidio. Borrow the windsurf board by the promenade to sail off the beach.

sight:cupertino-orchard-gardens.name: Cupertino Orchard Gardens
sight:cupertino-orchard-gardens.description: Orchard paths, shaded benches and flowering gardens make a quiet circuit around the ring campus. Short courts lead home to low roofs and gardens.

place:etc.name: Curiosity shop
place:etc.description: Other corners of the internet, a past life on the web, and a few digital curiosities.

sight:southern-corner-124.name: Cypress Flowers
sight:southern-corner-124.description: These are for somebody, even if that somebody turns out to be you. The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

actor:southern-corner-124-neighbor.name: Cypress Flowers shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-124-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

sight:deyoung.name: de Young Museum
sight:deyoung.description: A dark copper museum and a twisted observation tower overlook the Music Concourse. The Academy sits across the plaza.

sight:zoo-deer.name: Deer
sight:zoo-deer.description: Two deer browse peacefully. They have declined to comment on their neighbor’s recent escape.

actor:lucindas-proprietor.name: Deli proprietor
actor:lucindas-proprietor.description: A sandwich artisan whose delivery fleet fits inside the walk-in fridge. The flag is for morale.

actor:dog-pony-administrator.name: Dog and Pony Administrator
actor:dog-pony-administrator.description: A very small impresario with a clipboard, two exceptionally flexible employees, and complete confidence in the programme.

sight:dog-pony-show.name: Dog and Pony Show
sight:dog-pony-show.description: A striped little showground beside Foundry Lane. The dog and pony have rehearsed exactly one trick, and are extremely proud of it.

sight:house-search-2.name: Dog house
sight:house-search-2.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

actor:pacifica-dog-surf-judge.name: Dog surfing judge
actor:pacifica-dog-surf-judge.description: A local adventurer. Currently undertaking the difficult quest called “one more errand.”

sight:dolores.name: Dolores Park
sight:dolores.description: Palm trees and sloping lawns sit between the Mission and the Castro, with the downtown skyline beyond.

actor:noor-qualia.name: Dr. Noor Qualia
actor:noor-qualia.description: A phenomenologist whose lab notebook contains careful observations, many question marks, and one excellent soup recipe.

sight:duel-arena.name: Duel Arena
sight:duel-arena.description: A tiny garden arena, with a ramp and room for two large financial opinions. Equal coin stakes, explicit agreement, and a fair 50–50 flip. Speak to the referee or challenge another player here.

actor:duel-referee.name: Duel referee
actor:duel-referee.description: An impartial referee carrying one well-balanced coin and absolutely no spreadsheet for predicting which side it will land on.

actor:bolinas-emf-warrior.name: EMF warrior
actor:bolinas-emf-warrior.description: A coastal campaigner surrounded by an agitated chorus of radios.

actor:esoteric-professor.name: Esoteric researcher
actor:esoteric-professor.description: She has impeccable credentials in a field whose existence is fiercely disputed.

sight:fuel-outbound.name: Extortionate Gas Station
sight:fuel-outbound.description: The pump accepts every coin you have. The attendant calls this “market pricing.”

actor:market-farmer-0.name: Farmer Ada
actor:market-farmer-0.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

actor:market-farmer-1.name: Farmer Lin
actor:market-farmer-1.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

actor:market-farmer-2.name: Farmer Null
actor:market-farmer-2.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

actor:market-farmer-3.name: Farmer Root
actor:market-farmer-3.description: A farmer in a black coat and tiny dark sunglasses. Can see through the simulation, but still insists on exact change for kale.

sight:ferrari-car.name: Ferrari
sight:ferrari-car.description: A very fast red Ferrari: twenty times walking speed, with a tank that lasts 56% of the drive to Tahoe.

sight:ferrari-dealer.name: Ferrari Dealership
sight:ferrari-dealer.description: A red Ferrari waits beyond the Bay Bridge. Borrow it for free, drive at twenty times walking speed, and refuel here for free.

sight:ferry.name: Ferry Building
sight:ferry.description: The clock tower at the bay end of Market Street. Watch a streetcar roll past, then follow the waterfront north.

sight:wharf-fishing.name: Fisherman’s Wharf fishing spot
sight:wharf-fishing.description: Small fish gather below the wharf, flickering beneath the surface.

sight:fuel-tahoe.name: Free Gondola Gas
sight:fuel-tahoe.description: Free fuel beside the Tahoe gondola. Fill the tank before driving back to San Francisco.

place:freemasons-guild.name: Freemasons' Guild
place:freemasons-guild.description: A sandstone lodge with a checkerboard floor, brass compasses and an unusually well-funded refreshments committee. Ray, in the red suit, handles admission.

actor:green-banker.name: Friendly banker
actor:green-banker.description: A warm smile, a beautifully organized ledger, and a talent for remembering exactly how you take your coffee. Banking has rarely felt so hospitable.

actor:marin-bear.name: Friendly bear
actor:marin-bear.description: A big bear with small ambitions: sunshine, a nap, and perhaps your sandwich.

actor:ferrari-dealer-attendant.name: Fuel attendant
actor:ferrari-dealer-attendant.description: A pump attendant with a tiny nozzle embroidered on their cap. Their smile depends entirely on how many coins you are carrying.

sight:country-bench-0.name: Garden bench
sight:country-bench-0.description: A cedar bench, made for sitting a while. A very modest antidote to being in a hurry.

sight:peninsula-garden-office-58.name: Garden Studios
sight:peninsula-garden-office-58.description: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

sight:zoo-giraffes.name: Giraffes
sight:zoo-giraffes.description: A giraffe surveys the city from an enviable height. Still cannot find affordable housing.

actor:tam-goblin-1.name: Goblin
actor:tam-goblin-1.description: A Mount Tam goblin in heavy boots. The morning fog followed him down from the mountain.

actor:tam-furniture-maker.name: Goblin furniture maker
actor:tam-furniture-maker.description: Mount Tam’s most temperamental modernist. His ball chairs are round; his customer service is pointed.

sight:golden.name: Golden Gate Bridge
sight:golden.description: The orange towers span the Golden Gate between the Presidio and Marin. The Pacific opens to the west; the bay opens to the east.

sight:park.name: Golden Gate Park
sight:park.description: A long green escape on the western side of the city. Winding paths, cypress trees, and a pond full of very opinionated ducks.

sight:lore-explorable-home-7.name: Goose Corp invoice
sight:lore-explorable-home-7.description: The rest of the invoice has been torn off.

sight:gpu-factory.name: GPU Factory
sight:gpu-factory.description: A South Bay chip factory with north-light roof bays, clean-room windows, cooling pipes, and a surprisingly enthusiastic raw-materials department.

actor:gpu-factory-buyer.name: GPU Factory buyer
actor:gpu-factory-buyer.description: A clean-room procurement specialist. Has found a way to expense a trip to the beach.

actor:grain-merchant.name: Grain merchant
actor:grain-merchant.description: A patient keeper of tiny sacks. Every duck in the park considers this person a major philanthropist.

place:green.name: Green Bank
place:green.description: A global financial institution for the people and agents of the future. Speak to the friendly banker inside: deposited coins earn 5% interest per hour. Coffee is on the house.

actor:haberdasher-merchant.name: Haberdasher
actor:haberdasher-merchant.description: A meticulous milliner who can estimate your net worth to the nearest brim. Considers a crown sensible everyday wear.

sight:haberdasher.name: Haberdasher
sight:haberdasher.description: A little hat shop just north of the GPU Factory, with recessed hat displays, a striped canopy, and a projecting top-hat sign.

sight:hiking-supplies.name: Hiker’s supplies
sight:hiking-supplies.description: The summit lift attendant rents skis for one coin. Then ski the winding course and jump its ramps.

actor:hiking-supplier.name: Hiking supplies clerk
actor:hiking-supplier.description: Carries a reusable bag with the quiet confidence of someone who remembered to bring it.

sight:times-square-works.name: Hillsborough Works
sight:times-square-works.description: Two lattice cranes lift the next chapter of the neighborhood. A small fenced digsite, a patient excavator, and Vic’s clipboard keep the main square free for pedestrians.

place:explorable-home-1.name: House
place:explorable-home-1.description: A quiet home, keeping its own hours.

sight:whale-0.name: Humpback whale
sight:whale-0.description: A humpback surfaces in the Pacific, followed by a silver plume of spray. Windsurf into position and jump over its back.

actor:tahoe-giant-1.name: Ice giant
actor:tahoe-giant-1.description: A glacier has stood up, and it is not pleased about your carbon footprint.

sight:illuminati-stairway.name: Illuminati passage
sight:illuminati-stairway.description: A discreet stairway carved beneath the lodge.

sight:in-n-out.name: In-N-Out
sight:in-n-out.description: A double-double beacon beyond the Bay Bridge. The palm trees have excellent taste in roadside stops.

actor:in-n-out-clerk.name: In-N-Out associate
actor:in-n-out-clerk.description: Seems suspiciously well rested for someone living in a city with this much coffee.

place:home.name: John's place
place:home.description: A San Francisco resident, builder, and incurable optimist. Ring the bell and say hello.

actor:square-busker.name: June, street musician
actor:square-busker.description: A street musician playing a song the zoning board has yet to approve.

sight:southern-corner-57.name: Juniper Books
sight:southern-corner-57.description: We organize by the sort of afternoon you would like to have. The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

actor:southern-corner-57-neighbor.name: Juniper Books shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-57-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

sight:jurassic-biosciences.name: Jurassic Biosciences
sight:jurassic-biosciences.description: A gloriously indiscreet biosciences tower, topped by glass specimen lanterns, a DNA helix and some highly questionable scientific plumbing. A reinforced mesh enclosure stands outside.

actor:jurassic-scientist.name: Jurassic scientist
actor:jurassic-scientist.description: Seems suspiciously well rested for someone living in a city with this much coffee.

actor:pacific-kraken.name: Kraken
actor:pacific-kraken.description: A local adventurer. Currently undertaking the difficult quest called “one more errand.”

sight:merced.name: Lake Merced
sight:merced.description: A freshwater lake near the southwestern edge of the city, south of the Sunset and close to the Pacific.

sight:house-search-4.name: Laundry basket
sight:house-search-4.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

actor:square-bookseller.name: Leo, bookseller
actor:square-bookseller.description: A bookseller with first editions of books that have not yet been written.

place:limit.name: Limit
place:limit.description: Tools that changed the daily lives of thousands of insurance professionals.

sight:beach-billboard.name: Local Minimum AI billboard
sight:beach-billboard.description: A Local Minimum AI advertisement promises a little gradient descent by the sea. Even the beach has a pitch deck.

actor:south-lost-goblin.name: Lost Goblin
actor:south-lost-goblin.description: A Mount Tam resident who took a wrong turn at the redwoods. He blames the trail signs.

actor:lost-pirate.name: Lost Pirate
actor:lost-pirate.description: He followed the treasure map exactly. Unfortunately, it was a restaurant menu.

sight:lucindas-deli.name: Lucinda’s Deli
sight:lucindas-deli.description: A busy neighborhood deli with a well-used counter and the smell of freshly baked bread.

place:books.name: Main Library · Bookshelf
place:books.description: Fiction and non-fiction that stay with you, long after the last page.

sight:ducks.name: Mallards & ducklings
sight:ducks.description: Mallards and little ducklings paddle around the pond. They seem certain you brought something for them.

sight:marin-bridge-landing.name: Marin Headlands overlook
sight:marin-bridge-landing.description: Across the Golden Gate, the Marin hills look back over the orange towers and San Francisco.

actor:mazarine-clerk.name: Mazarine clerk
actor:mazarine-clerk.description: A local shopkeeper, keeping this corner of the neighborhood busy.

place:links.name: Mazarine Coffee
place:links.description: Coffee on Market Street. Bani is enjoying a table inside Mazarine; browse a few connections to the rest of the internet over coffee.

sight:lore-freemasons-guild.name: Minutes of the Refreshments Committee
sight:lore-freemasons-guild.description: A red ledger rests open beside the lodge’s biscuits.

actor:mira-softmax.name: Mira Softmax
actor:mira-softmax.description: A researcher carrying seven meditation timers, all confidently disagreeing about when the present begins.

actor:square-barista.name: Mira, coffee seller
actor:square-barista.description: A barista measuring the progress of the neighborhood in empty cups.

sight:zoo-motorcycle.name: Motorcycle
sight:zoo-motorcycle.description: A parked motorcycle with a gleaming tank and a neatly printed rental note: “5 coins.”

actor:zoo-motorcycle-clerk.name: Motorcycle rental clerk
actor:zoo-motorcycle-clerk.description: A motorcycle rental clerk with a well-oiled keyring and a remarkably patient smile.

sight:mount-tam-goblins.name: Mount Tam Goblin Town
sight:mount-tam-goblins.description: A muddy path north of the jail leads to the Mount Tam goblins’ settlement. Redwood offcuts, fog jars, and a furniture workshop have made the journey down the mountain.

sight:gondola-base.name: Mountain gondola
sight:gondola-base.description: A gondola climbs the immense mountain above Lake Tahoe.

sight:southern-craft-1.name: Neighborhood garden
sight:southern-craft-1.description: Herringbone paving, flowering pots, a cedar bench, and shade stitched together by the neighbors. A small but very good place to pause.

sight:nightlife.name: Nightlife
sight:nightlife.description: A little nightclub in the South Mission, two blocks north of its former home. Mirror ball, colored dance floor, and two regulars with very firm relationship boundaries.

sight:beach.name: Ocean Beach
sight:beach.description: The long Pacific shoreline beside the Great Highway. Golden Gate Park reaches the beach to the north, and the Sunset stretches inland.

sight:ocean-pocket-garden.name: Ocean Terrace Garden
sight:ocean-pocket-garden.description: A little neighborhood garden: flowering pots, a shaded bench, and a thoroughly unmonetized view.

actor:illuminati-old-man.name: Old Man
actor:illuminati-old-man.description: An Old Man with silver hair, a very discreet lapel pin, and a philanthropic interest in exactly 250,000 of your coins.

sight:lore-explorable-home-1.name: On the Ownership of Ponds
sight:lore-explorable-home-1.description: A slim volume with a surprisingly extensive legal appendix.

sight:oracle.name: Oracle Park
sight:oracle.description: A brick ballpark opens toward McCovey Cove, with green grass, tiered stands, and tall floodlights above the waterfront.

sight:southern-village-gardens.name: Orchard and Foundry Gardens
sight:southern-village-gardens.description: Linked garden courts, tea tables, little bookshops and a birdwatching pergola link a quiet residential neighborhood to the foundry. The institutes sit farther south, beyond the lake and pasture.

actor:tablet-wizard.name: Orin the Wizard
actor:tablet-wizard.description: Appears to be mentally composing a strongly worded review of the weather.

place:orin-house.name: Orin’s house
place:orin-house.description: A quiet Victorian west of Sand Hill Road Capital Partners. Orin sells teleportation tablets inside.

actor:south-grove-outlaw.name: Outlaw
actor:south-grove-outlaw.description: A woodland entrepreneur whose entire business model is your pockets.

sight:pacifica-park.name: Pacifica Commons
sight:pacifica-park.description: Pacifica Commons: a neighborhood green with a fountain, shaded benches, and paths for a very unhurried lap. The ocean air is complimentary.

sight:pacifica-surf.name: Pacifica surfboards
sight:pacifica-surf.description: Bright boards wait on the Pacifica beach. Paddle into the foam lines, press Space to catch a wave, and use 1 / 2 / 3 for an Air 360, kickflip or backflip. U returns to the beach.

sight:painted.name: Painted Ladies
sight:painted.description: A row of colorful Victorian houses overlooking Alamo Square. A good place to pause before riding west to the park.

sight:palace.name: Palace of Fine Arts
sight:palace.description: A sandstone-colored rotunda rises beside a little lagoon. Its dome and colonnade mark the eastern edge of the Presidio and the Marina.

sight:southern-corner-129.name: Palmetto Pottery
sight:southern-corner-129.description: Every mug is a little different. The one with the wobble is about the nature of certainty. The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

actor:southern-corner-129-neighbor.name: Palmetto Pottery shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-129-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

sight:windmill.name: Park windmill
sight:windmill.description: A timber windmill and flower beds stand near the park’s western end. Beyond the Great Highway, Ocean Beach opens onto the Pacific.

sight:zoo-penguins.name: Penguins
sight:zoo-penguins.description: A committee of penguins, formally dressed for a meeting about fish. The motion passes unanimously.

actor:police.name: Police
actor:police.description: An officer of the law. Their stamina appears to be funded in perpetuity.

actor:twitter-poster.name: Poster
actor:twitter-poster.description: A poster staring into a phone. Someone, somewhere, has made a statement that cannot be allowed to stand.

sight:presidio.name: Presidio · Main Post
sight:presidio.description: Wooded hills give way to a broad parade ground, a flagpole, and rows of red-roof barracks. Trails lead toward Crissy Field, Lovers Lane, and the Golden Gate.

sight:airship.name: Private Jet Terminal
sight:airship.description: The private jet terminal occupies the building east of the runway. Its passenger entrance faces the airship mooring to the north. Click Rent airship or press A nearby; click the ground or minimap to fly, and A returns to the mooring.

actor:ada-meridian.name: Professor Ada Meridian
actor:ada-meridian.description: A director with a chalk-dusted coat and a compass that points toward the nearest open grant application.

actor:elias-index.name: Professor Elias Index
actor:elias-index.description: A professor with a very small ruler and an extraordinarily large jurisdictional dispute.

sight:prometheus.name: Prometheus
sight:prometheus.description: Prometheus lifts an eternal flame over the bay. The fire is for everyone; the birds have interpreted this as including the pedestal.

sight:qualia-bookshop.name: Qualia Books
sight:qualia-bookshop.description: A little bookshop beside the institutes. Its shelves run from practical gardening to deeply impractical theories of mind.

actor:qualia-bookshop-neighbor.name: Qualia Books shopkeeper
actor:qualia-bookshop-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

actor:rail-lunch-worker.name: Rail worker
actor:rail-lunch-worker.description: An excavator operator protecting a sandwich of considerable historical significance.

actor:guild-ray.name: Ray
actor:guild-ray.description: Ray wears a red suit, a brass lapel compass and the serene expression of a man with a very orderly filing cabinet.

actor:software-vendor.name: Redheaded software salesman
actor:software-vendor.description: A redheaded salesman selling the software that sells the software. His business card has a business card.

sight:southern-lake-meadows.name: Redwood Lake and Meadows
sight:southern-lake-meadows.description: A wooded lake, open cow pasture, cottage gardens and colorful city flats along connected neighborhood lanes. The rival consciousness institutes stand side by side on a shared promenade off South Grove Avenue.

sight:redwood-office-court.name: Redwood Office Court
sight:redwood-office-court.description: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

actor:rehabilitation-specialist.name: Rehabilitation specialist
actor:rehabilitation-specialist.description: A spotless white coat, an immaculate bedside manner, and an enormous apparatus that has never once appeared in a medical textbook.

sight:rich-table.name: Rich Table
sight:rich-table.description: A little Hayes Valley house with a Rich Table sign. Neighbors share dinner at the tables outside.

actor:lucindas-deli-diner-0.name: Rich Table diner
actor:lucindas-deli-diner-0.description: Contemplating a small plate with the seriousness usually reserved for a lunar landing.

place:rose.name: Rose
place:rose.description: A healthier home, starting with the environment around you.

actor:rowan-zero.name: Rowan Zero
actor:rowan-zero.description: The facilities lead. Their keyring is labeled “ground truth” and opens considerably more doors than the institute’s theories do.

sight:salesforce.name: Salesforce Tower
sight:salesforce.description: Broad glass façades taper toward a flat rooftop and a softly illuminated crown over the dense towers south of Market. The Transamerica Pyramid stands farther north.

actor:salt-conservationist.name: Salt conservationist
actor:salt-conservationist.description: A salt conservationist with muddy boots, a stack of envelopes, and several strongly worded opinions about the phrase vacant land.

sight:zoo.name: San Francisco Zoo
sight:zoo.description: A leafy zoo west of Lake Merced. The tiger has excellent stripes and a troubling interest in the gate latch.

actor:sand-hill-partner.name: Sand Hill Road Capital Partner
actor:sand-hill-partner.description: A venture capitalist who interprets “strong fundamentals” as a personal bench-press record. Their term sheet doubles as a workout plan.

sight:sand-hill-capital.name: Sand Hill Road Capital Partners
sight:sand-hill-capital.description: A capital firm with immaculate landscaping and some unusually heavy office furniture.

sight:sand-hill-woods.name: Sand Hill Woodland Park
sight:sand-hill-woods.description: A shaded Sand Hill grove of coast live oaks, redwoods, winding paths, and remarkably patient venture capital. The benches have excellent runway.

sight:southern-corner-127.name: Seabreeze Bakery
sight:southern-corner-127.description: The fog is an excellent proving drawer. The sourdough has lived here longer than I have. The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

actor:southern-corner-127-neighbor.name: Seabreeze Bakery shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-127-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

actor:waterfront-seagull-0.name: Seagull
actor:waterfront-seagull-0.description: A waterfront regular with strong opinions about unattended sandwiches.

actor:secondary-merchant.name: Secondary purchaser
actor:secondary-merchant.description: Their eyes light up at the words “liquid secondary.” Their shoes have already priced in the upside.

sight:sf-fitness.name: SF Fitness
sight:sf-fitness.description: An open-air gym with well-used benches, neatly racked weights, and excellent ventilation.

sight:shanghai-kelly.name: Shanghai Kelly’s
sight:shanghai-kelly.description: A neighborhood bar with a polished counter and a floor that has heard every story.

sight:dolores-skate-dog.name: Skateboarding dog
sight:dolores-skate-dog.description: Four paws, four wheels, and absolutely no municipal skateboarding permit. A very good dog.

actor:summit-lift-attendant.name: Ski lift attendant
actor:summit-lift-attendant.description: An experienced lift attendant in a warm parka. Has witnessed every conceivable interpretation of the phrase last run.

actor:tahoe-giant-0.name: Snow giant
actor:tahoe-giant-0.description: An ancient snowdrift with fists. Its scarf is a small avalanche.

sight:sales-conference.name: Software Sales Conference
sight:sales-conference.description: A red-and-cream circus tent dedicated to selling sales software to people who sell sales software. The ringmaster calls it a pipeline.

actor:software-buyer-1.name: Software salesman
actor:software-buyer-1.description: A conference delegate considering a sales funnel within a sales funnel. The lanyard is doing most of the work.

actor:soren-still.name: Soren Still
actor:soren-still.description: A contemplative fellow taking a very slow walk around the bench he identifies as “compute infrastructure.”

sight:south-cow-pen.name: Southern cow pasture
sight:south-cow-pen.description: Cows graze in an open meadow. They seem entirely unconcerned with the afternoon.

actor:sf-spaceport-attendant.name: SpaceX attendant
actor:sf-spaceport-attendant.description: An attendant with a flight manifest and immaculate coveralls. The clipboard says “Reusable” with a reassuring number of check marks.

sight:sf-spaceport.name: SpaceX spaceport
sight:sf-spaceport.description: A SpaceX reusable rocket and landing pad. Speak to the attendant for a one-coin flight between San Francisco and Tahoe.

actor:square-diner.name: Square Coffee patron
actor:square-diner.description: She came for coffee and stayed to watch an entire neighborhood change its mind.

sight:zoo-monkeys.name: Squirrel monkeys
sight:zoo-monkeys.description: Two squirrel monkeys debate the nature of experience. One has already stolen the footnotes.

sight:illuminati-exit.name: Stairs to the guild
sight:illuminati-exit.description: A long stairway returns to the Freemasons’ Guild above. The public minimap resumes on the surface.

actor:founder-merchant.name: Startup founder
actor:founder-merchant.description: A founder with a pitch deck in one pocket and several possible futures in the other. The vest is pre-revenue.

sight:startup-hq.name: Startup HQ
sight:startup-hq.description: A small startup house on a quiet side lane off the peninsula highway. The orange Y Combinator sign hangs over the door.

actor:times-square-stockbroker.name: Stockbroker
actor:times-square-stockbroker.description: A broker with a pocket watch, a tidy ledger, and an impressive ability to describe a falling number as price discovery.

sight:unlabelled-ground.name: Street / unlabelled scenery
sight:unlabelled-ground.description: Unlabelled scenery uses the ground action menu.

sight:gondola-summit.name: Summit gondola
sight:gondola-summit.description: A gondola climbs the immense mountain above Lake Tahoe.

sight:ski-rental.name: Summit ski rental
sight:ski-rental.description: The summit lift attendant rents skis for one coin. Then ski the winding course and jump its ramps.

sight:sutro.name: Sutro Tower
sight:sutro.description: The red-and-white broadcasting tower rises between Mount Sutro and Twin Peaks. Three splayed legs, triangular crossbeams and slender antenna masts make its unmistakable silhouette above the trees.

states: At the top of Sutro Tower

sight:tahoe-spaceport.name: Tahoe SpaceX spaceport
sight:tahoe-spaceport.description: A SpaceX reusable rocket and landing pad. Speak to the attendant for a one-coin flight between San Francisco and Tahoe.

actor:tax-authority-0.name: Tax authority
actor:tax-authority-0.description: A gilded suit, a towering hat, and an unwavering belief that your pockets contain public infrastructure.

sight:tax-hq.name: Tax Authority Headquarters
sight:tax-hq.description: The Tax Authority Headquarters. Gilded officials in top hats patrol the forecourt.

place:sunset-whole-foods.name: Technologist's Farmers Market
place:sunset-whole-foods.description: Heirloom produce, black coats and exceptionally small sunglasses. The farmers grow the future, mostly in vials.

actor:abandoned-factory-terminator.name: Terminator
actor:abandoned-factory-terminator.description: An abandoned building, a red eye, and a very persistent tenant.

sight:tesla-robotaxi-1.name: Tesla robotaxi
sight:tesla-robotaxi-1.description: A low, silver Tesla robotaxi with a panoramic roof and a very quiet electric motor. Its passenger is reading a book about the future of work.

actor:robotaxi-sales.name: Tesla robotaxi dealer
actor:robotaxi-sales.description: An autonomous-income salesperson. The car has no driver, but the invoice has excellent handwriting.

sight:tesla-robotaxi.name: Tesla robotaxi dealership
sight:tesla-robotaxi.description: A small South Bay showroom of gold autonomous cabs. A showroom attendant has polished every windscreen to a golden shine.

sight:the-armory.name: The Armory
sight:the-armory.description: Strangely, this is not where you buy armor.

place:press.name: The newsstand
place:press.description: Extra, extra. News, conversations, and dispatches from the world of building companies.

sight:panhandle.name: The Panhandle
sight:panhandle.description: The narrow green strip continuing east from Golden Gate Park between Fell and Oak. Cycle beneath the trees, pass the park monument, and continue toward Alamo Square.

sight:pequod.name: The Pequod
sight:pequod.description: Captain Ahab’s whaling ship. Its timbers smell of salt, tar, and extremely stubborn ambition.

sight:campus-tea-room.name: The Present Tense · Tea Room
sight:campus-tea-room.description: A cedar-and-limestone tea room with a sheltered canopy and outdoor tables. The tea is warm; the discussion is pleasantly inconclusive.

actor:campus-tea-room-neighbor.name: The Present Tense · Tea Room shopkeeper
actor:campus-tea-room-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

sight:lore-explorable-home-8.name: The Quarterly Honk
sight:lore-explorable-home-8.description: A household magazine, addressed to “The Current Beneficial Occupant”.

sight:southern-corner-85.name: The Terrace
sight:southern-corner-85.description: A coffee, a sunny chair, and absolutely no plans to pivot. The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

actor:southern-corner-85-neighbor.name: The Terrace shopkeeper
actor:southern-corner-85-neighbor.description: A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.

sight:tiger.name: Tiger
sight:tiger.description: An excellent tiger. It has never read a single warning sign.

actor:tim-apple.name: Tim Apple
actor:tim-apple.description: Tim Apple, surrounded by very round architecture. His pockets contain one thousand songs and several hundred unread notifications.

sight:tim-apple-campus.name: Tim Apple campus
sight:tim-apple-campus.description: A gleaming donut of curved glass and white aluminum, with a real open courtyard and northern gateway.

sight:times-square-stock-exchange.name: Times Square Stock Exchange
sight:times-square-stock-exchange.description: A surprisingly compact stock exchange. The broker lists Sand Hill growth equity for a five-percent fee, then lets you try your hand at timing the market.

sight:house-search-5.name: Tool box
sight:house-search-5.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:pyramid.name: Transamerica Pyramid
sight:pyramid.description: A pale, tapering pyramid with a gridded façade and projecting side wings. A small redwood plaza softens the base of the Financial District landmark.

sight:house-search-8.name: Travelling trunk
sight:house-search-8.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:peaks.name: Twin Peaks
sight:peaks.description: The central ridgeline rises between the Sunset and the Castro. Follow the winding trail for a different view of the city.

sight:twitter-hq.name: Twitter HQ
sight:twitter-hq.description: Messages travel down a conveyor, into bottles and out to sea. The backend is surprisingly wet.

sight:ucsf.name: UCSF Hospital
sight:ucsf.description: UCSF Hospital. Excellent emergency care, including the surprisingly common diagnosis “opened the tiger gate.”

actor:jurassic-raptor.name: Velociraptor
actor:jurassic-raptor.description: Seems suspiciously well rested for someone living in a city with this much coffee.

place:venture.name: Venture exchange
place:venture.description: An arcade of ambitious companies. Meet the builders working on what comes next.

actor:square-foreman.name: Vic, demolition foreman
actor:square-foreman.description: The excavator operator has traded a quiet suburb for a very interesting afternoon. His clipboard now lives at the digsite beside the square.

sight:house-search-6.name: Wardrobe
sight:house-search-6.description: A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

sight:waymo-1.name: Waymo
sight:waymo-1.description: An autonomous white taxi with a spinning rooftop sensor and absolutely no driver to ask for directions. It is patiently touring the whole city, one impeccably calculated turn at a time.

actor:coit-parrot-0.name: Wild parrot
actor:coit-parrot-0.description: A cherry-headed Telegraph Hill parrot. Small bird, enormous neighborhood opinions.

sight:windsurf.name: Windsurfing
sight:windsurf.description: A windsurf board and rig wait beside Crissy Field. Click the bay to sail; use Return to shore when you are ready to land.

actor:yohji.name: Yohji
actor:yohji.description: Carries a reusable bag with the quiet confidence of someone who remembered to bring it.

sight:zoo-office.name: Zoo keeper’s office
sight:zoo-office.description: Several nets, one kettle, and an employee handbook with a heavily underlined chapter on tigers.

actor:monkey-zookeeper.name: Zookeeper
actor:monkey-zookeeper.description: A watchful zookeeper with an extremely literal interpretation of ‘monkey business.’

sight:monkey-keeper-post.name: Zookeeper’s post
sight:monkey-keeper-post.description: A remarkably athletic zookeeper is keeping a close eye on the monkey habitat.

actor:south-cow-1.description: Seems suspiciously well rested for someone living in a city with this much coffee.

actor:south-cow-2.description: Walking with purpose, although the purpose may simply be a very specific sandwich.

actor:south-cow-3.description: Carries a reusable bag with the quiet confidence of someone who remembered to bring it.

actor:south-cow-4.description: Appears to be mentally composing a strongly worded review of the weather.

actor:south-cow-5.description: Knows a shortcut. Will probably describe it using a café that closed in 2018.

actor:south-cow-6.description: Their jacket is prepared for three microclimates. Their ankles are prepared for none.

actor:south-cow-7.description: Has the air of someone who has just explained a very niche hobby to a captive audience.
